name: Winn
source:
The Cool and collected Fae

A powerful, but difficult, companion - Winn seems to be skeptical of each decision you make. Will you be able to make a lasting impression on a cold Fae’s heart?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1503355560909017088?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
